title: BetMate
tagline: BetMate lets you bet on who will be on top of the Premier League final table.
description:
BetMate lets you bet on who will be on top of the Premier League final table. 

I ran out of time and couldn't make a functional app. These are Figma designs and contracts that I hope to convert to a functional app in the coming hackathons.

I'm planning to extend the scope of the project by letting the users predict the top 5 clubs on the table. It will be more fun because users can choose from 77520 possibilities compared to the current 20.
how_its_made:
The Dapp is made with ScaffoldEth2 boiler plate and hosted on the Mode Network. 
I'm planning to use ScaffoldEth2 because it is a good starting point for a hackathon project. I'm planning to use Mode because it is new and I want to see how it works. 
This is most of the information I have as of now. I plan on updating these sections later.
